authority: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board / Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

clauses.clause: Section 25, Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
clauses.heading: Consent to Establish (Water)
clauses.text: No person shall, without the previous consent of the State Board, establish or take any steps to establish any industry which is likely to discharge sewage or trade effluent into a stream.

clauses.clause: Section 21, Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
clauses.heading: Consent to Establish (Air)
clauses.text: No person shall, without the previous consent of the State Board, establish or operate any industrial plant in an air pollution control area.

clauses.heading: Industry pollution category classification
clauses.text: Industries are classified as Red, Orange, Green, or White based on their pollution potential. Category determines the type of environmental consent required.
